reviews.title: Loses its finesse after you learn
reviews.text: Greg gives a really in-depth look at all of your plants, asking the pot type, distance from the sun, window orientation, etc. But surprisingly, it does not allow you to alter its suggested watering schedule. After following Greg suggestions for about two months, I noticed that many of my plants were showing signs of overwatering. I hate how great the app is in so many different ways, but keeping the watering schedule under lock and key is detrimental to my rating. Please make this fix Greg and you will be the best plant app around!

reviews.title: Useless

reviews.title: Just not intuitive
reviews.text:
I wanted to love this app but it’s just no intuitive. It’s not some pretty significant bugs, like when I’m trying to swipe in between my plants, it only loads info on one plant and the rest of the pages are black. This was when I cancelled the free membership. 

My phone is fully updated, the app was updated so I know it wasn’t a mismatch there. As an app developers wife, it’s just not up to par with how apps should be.

reviews.title: Lots of bugs and short sighted design
reviews.text: App’s ai isn’t actually very good. It really can’t estimate a pot size very accurately. It guessed my 4 inch pot was a 12. It also can’t guess plants all that great. More than half of my plants it confidently named with 90-99% confidence a plant that isn’t even vaguely similar. For instance my sun dew is a fern. I don’t actually really care about that but if you don’t know what your plant is this probably won’t help. What is pretty annoying is that when you use the identify to add a plant, if you don’t accept the wrong identification and try to scroll or look up another plant the app will crash about 80% of the time. The other problem I have with this seems pretty obvious if anyone tested the app. Any of the pages in the community tab don’t seem to have a way to back out of them. You will click on someone’s post or the leaderboard or almost anything and the navigation bar on the bottom will go away. With no back arrow you now need to close out the app completely. Super user unfriendly.

reviews.title: It’s cute
reviews.text: Cute app for tracking and identifying your plants, but the watering schedule is totally unreliable and random. Super Greg doesn’t have any useful features. Also I had to have support do a full swap to a new account for me because the app was so buggy I couldn’t access any of the plants I added after a while. Wish we could program the watering schedule ourselves so it’s accurate.—— I see the dev reply. Obviously you guys have programmed a watering schedule system, when I say it’s “random” I mean it doesn’t correctly account for factors that would affect the actual watering needs of the plant. It’s dishonest to suggest that it’s accurate for everyone. I live at high altitude and my plants dry out much faster and take more intense sunlight. So perhaps I’m an outlier.

reviews.title: Good news and bad news
reviews.text:
I started out really liking this app.  Yes, I bought the ‘premium’ to take advantage of the watering reminders, which I did like.  As my plants were on  a different watering schedule, some every 5,7, 11, and 14 day schedule. I wasn’t over watering or under watering.
  Along comes a phone update, I lost my plant data, photos and all, so I had to reenter all plants and info.  Well guess what?  ALL my plants are set on a 14 day schedule!  I am unable to correct  the watering schedule, or my plant zone. Oh! And I also downloaded the updated GREG app, but it didn’t help. Help and support wasn’t helpful. 
That ain’t right!

reviews.title: Ai and plant ID never foolproof
reviews.text: I have 100’s if not thousands of succulents and when I started inputting them it got the majority of them wrong. Just like most AI identifiers it cannot recognize the vast plethora of varieties and hybrids that are present in the succulent theater. Would not recommend for accurate ID. I cannot attest to the other features but I suspect the watering calculator to be faulty as well. I recommend not purchasing until you are aware of usefulness.
